question: Who makes Avoprokenya avocado oil brand parent company
markdown:
The Avoprokenya avocado oil brand is made by its parent company and primary operator,
Avopro EPZ Limited
(also known as Avopro Kenya Ltd), a private manufacturing and processing enterprise headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya, with its factory operations located in Sagana/Kirinyaga County. You can learn more about their operations directly on the
⁠Avoprokenya Official Website
Company Details
Company Name:
Avopro EPZ Limited
Headquarters:
Nairobi, Kenya
Factory Location:
Sagana, Kirinyaga County, Kenya
Core Business:
Processing extra virgin cold-pressed and crude avocado oil sourced from local Kenyan smallholder farmers.
